name: TextShimmer
description: Text with a band of light sweeping across it, for a loading message or a quiet accent. The words stay real text: selectable and read as normal.

baseColor.description: The resting colour of the text, any CSS colour. Defaults to the muted text colour.

highlightColor.description: The colour of the passing light, any CSS colour. Defaults to the main text colour.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and the effect can also be shown still with the rdm-still class
Both colours meet 4.5:1 against the page, so the text is readable at every point of the sweep
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode it is drawn in the system text colour with no effect
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
screenReader: Read as ordinary text: the sweep is purely visual

use_when: A short label that should feel alive
avoid_when: Anything the user must read closely
anti_patterns: Choosing two colours that are close in lightness, which makes the sweep invisible
